sections.heading: ✅ This Week's Highlights
items: **1. Post-Update Infra Recovery — All Three Breakages Fixed** — Two Hermes updates this week each broke something, and both were diagnosed and repaired. The Sep 30 update dropped macOS Full Disk Access (vault unreadable from Hermes until Oct 1 evening); the Oct 4 01:18 update dropped pyyaml from the managed env (WebUI crash-loop, 323 import failures). Both fixed; Full Disk Access now live for every Hermes process; WebUI permanently on a self-healing managed wrapper. Same window also fixed: Reminders↔Google Tasks sync (wedged EventKit — cleared via `remindctl authorize`), Mnemosyne packages re-homed into the runtime venv (memory consolidation works again; Sleep job rewired to a zero-token script driver), and vault auto-sync hardened (fail fast + reap stuck children) after the Oct 3 evening git-transfer hangs.

**2. Vault Access Chain Restored + Journals Backfilled** — The journal pipeline had been dead since Sep 29 (Session Journal + Deploy and Daily Cleanup paused) — both resumed Oct 4, and the missing Oct 1–3 session summaries were backfilled from session records, cron DBs, and git history. Vault git is back in sync with origin; validation clean at 548 notes, 0 invalid.
**3. SER8 Back Online After ~14 Days** — Ping + BatchMode SSH verified on 100.73.4.38. The Prometheus node-exporter install is now blocked only on Ayush's sudo password.

**4. Publisher Repo Divergence Resolved** — `agent/public-knowledge-site` had drifted 519 sync commits vs 3 upstream; origin/main merged behind safety tag `backup-premerge-20261004` and pushed. ayumad.me and the blog both serving 200s.

**5. NAS Name-Resolution Failure Root-Caused** — The Mac mini's "connect to server 'nas'" dialog could never succeed — the short name `nas` doesn't resolve from the mini's subnet (the share answers on :445 by IP everywhere). Pattern recorded: hand clients `smb://<ip>` / tailnet IP / MagicDNS `ayumacmini`, not `.local`.
